quote: Speech Recognition transcribs visual and audio data into text form
For all experiments on LRS2, we use the word error rate (WER) as the evaluation index of speech recognition

For all experiments on LRS2, we use the word error rate (WER) as the evaluation index of speech recognition (both lip-reading and AVSR). WER can be defined as WER=(S + D + I)/M , where S, D, I, M represent the number of words replaced, deleted, inserted and referenced respectively.
